title: Environmental logger sample
caption: Sample input only. Exact values from the grapher’s existing three-row CSV fixture; not measured aerodynamic performance.
methodology: Values reproduced from the earlier source record without smoothing, extrapolation, or correction. Elapsed time is calculated from the sample timestamps.
limitations: Three example rows demonstrate the input format. They do not establish a physical trend, calibration, lift, drag, or tunnel performance.
